openings.claim: Relevant assignment intervals may restore weekly selection.
openings.discriminator: Changing current assignments alters incumbent selection but not interval-aware selection.
openings.probe: Hold attendance/identities fixed; compare unchanged/reassigned staging fixtures against agreed weekly sets before CSV generation.
openings.uncertainty: History, midweek inclusion rules and feasibility unverified; correlation is not causation.

openings.claim: Renames may cause recognition failure or omission.
openings.discriminator: Reconciled identities distinguish present-but-unrecognized from missing rows.
openings.probe: Observe fabricated rename checking/importing with old/new labels; trace identities internally and time steps.
openings.uncertainty: Schema-preserving identity tracing unverified; fabricated results cannot establish production success.

openings.claim: Authorized center/week course-ID manifests replace assignment-based selection, include zero-attendance courses, preserve rename identities and explicitly decide splits.
openings.discriminator: Fixed attendance/manifests withstand assignment changes; stale manifests still fail.
openings.probe: Compare reassignment/rename/zero-attendance/split fixtures; test foreign course/participant references. Six coordinators, two sessions: independently establish intended sets; time preparation/checking/correction/download/import.
openings.uncertainty: Needs scoped IDs/links, private editor/store, week/split mappings, timely complete timetables, authorization/row ownership, authorized delivery and consistent nonblocking reads. Approval overhead may erase savings.

decision: Diagnose before choosing D1/D3. Verify private/authorized processing, existing CSV, <=6 engineer-days, existing hosting, concurrent attendance and isolation including splits. Zero sampled leaks excludes the split center. Replacement-delivery delay remains separate; handling components unmeasured. If feasible, assess next 40: median <=12 minutes, intended sets >=95%, zero foreign records. Evidence: stipulated synthetic.
